features.title: Features Built for Big-Screen EPUB Reading

cards.title: Made for Roku TV
bullets: Designed for Roku TV and remote control navigation
Large labels, clear focus states, and simple D-pad movement
Move between Connect, Library, Settings, Help, and the full-screen reader
TV-optimized screens for comfortable reading from the couch

cards.title: Easy Local Pairing
bullets: Connect from a phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network
Scan the QR code shown on your Roku screen
Use the short manual address if you prefer typing the link
Connection status and retry options help you reconnect when needed

cards.title: EPUB Selection
bullets: Choose one EPUB, multiple EPUBs, or a folder where supported
Drag and drop EPUB files in supported browsers
Duplicate selections are skipped so your library stays clean
Selected books show file size, page count, and remove actions

cards.title: EPUB Book Support
bullets: Supports EPUB books selected from your own device
Handles many standard EPUB titles, covers, images, and metadata
Supports reflowable books with TV-friendly page display
Supports localized and Unicode EPUB file names

cards.title: Remote-Friendly Library
bullets: Browse selected EPUBs in a Roku-friendly grid
Book cards show first-page thumbnails and clean file names
Open the focused EPUB with the OK button
Empty library guidance sends you back to the Connect screen

cards.title: Full-Screen EPUB Reader
bullets: Read selected EPUB books in a full-screen TV viewer
Use Left and Right to move between pages
Use Back to return to the Library without losing the active session
The reader keeps your last visible page on screen during brief loading moments

cards.title: Reading Controls
bullets: Increase or decrease text size for more comfortable reading
Reset text size when you want the default view
Choose page background colors for different reading conditions
Toggle night mode for easier dark-room reading

cards.title: Search and Navigation
bullets: Search inside EPUB text from the Roku reader
Review matching page numbers and snippets
Jump from a search result directly to the matching page
Use simple D-pad navigation for search results

cards.title: Page Thumbnails
bullets: Open a full-screen page thumbnail navigator
Browse nearby pages with a focused center thumbnail
Select a thumbnail to jump directly to that page
Cancel thumbnail navigation without changing pages

cards.title: Go to Page
bullets: Open a TV-friendly numeric keypad
Enter a page number with the D-pad and OK button
Delete digits before submitting
Jump only to valid pages within the current EPUB

cards.title: Resume Reading
bullets: Reopen an EPUB at the last page you were reading
Restore saved page, text size, background color, and night mode
Open new EPUBs with sensible default viewing settings
Return from the reader to the Library without clearing your selected books

cards.title: Subscription Support
bullets: Subscribe or manage your subscription from the app menu
Subscription purchase and recovery flows use the Roku channel store
Free users may be limited to the first configured number of pages per EPUB
Subscribed users can continue reading later pages without the page limit prompt

cards.title: Settings and Storage Tools
bullets: View TV screen resolution and screen ratio
Check temporary viewing file count and storage usage
Clear temporary storage when needed
See clear success, no-data, and failure messages for cleanup actions

cards.title: Help, Legal, and Support
bullets: Built-in Help/FAQ page with expandable questions
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use pages
About page with app, developer, and version details
Support and feedback page with QR codes for useful links

cards.title: Local Viewing Design
bullets: EPUB files are selected from your own phone, tablet, or computer
No external upload service is required for EPUB content
Roku does not persist original EPUB files
Temporary viewing data can be cleared from Settings

cards.title: Localization Ready
bullets: Roku interface text uses localized app strings
Reader controls, page prompts, settings, and subscription messages support translation
The browser selection page includes localized status and error messages
Browser language selection can be stored locally

items.text: Enjoy EPUB books on a larger screen with simple remote navigation, text zoom, background colors, and night mode.

items.title: Shared Reading

items.title: Local Wi-Fi Viewing
items.text: Choose EPUB files from a phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network without needing an external upload service.

items.q: What is TV EPUB Viewer?
items.a: TV EPUB Viewer is a Roku app for reading EPUB books on your TV with a remote-friendly interface.

items.q: How do I open EPUB books on my Roku TV?
items.a: Open the Connect screen, scan the QR code or enter the short address from a phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network, then choose the EPUB files you want to read.

items.q: Which book format is supported?
items.a: The app is designed for EPUB books.

items.q: Can I search inside a book?
items.a: Yes. The reader includes EPUB text search with results that can jump to matching pages.

items.q: Can I choose more than one EPUB?
items.a: Yes. You can select multiple EPUB files, and folder selection may also be available on supported devices and browsers.

items.q: Do my device and Roku need to be on the same Wi-Fi network?
items.a: Yes. The phone, tablet, or computer used to choose EPUB books should be connected to the same local Wi-Fi network as your Roku device.

items.q: Does the app remember where I stopped?
items.a: Yes. The reader can reopen an EPUB with the last page and reading settings such as text size, background color, and night mode.

items.q: Can I change the reading view?
items.a: Yes. The options overlay includes text zoom, background color, night mode, thumbnails, search, Go to Page, and close controls.

items.q: Does Roku store my original EPUB files?
items.a: No. TV EPUB Viewer is designed for local reading and does not persist original EPUB files on Roku. Temporary viewing data can be cleared from Settings.

items.q: Where can I manage subscription information?
items.a: The app includes Subscribe and Manage Subscription options. Subscription purchase and recovery use the Roku channel store flow.
